questions.q: What are the four phases of the capstone project plan, in order?
options: Model, data, backtest, report
Data & statistical analysis; features, model & signal; backtest & risk; report & presentation
Presentation, backtest, features, data
Signal, data, risk, model
questions.explain: The plan is: (1) data and statistical analysis, (2) features, model, and signal, (3) backtest and risk, and (4) report and presentation — each chapter builds on the previous one's conclusion.

questions.q: What role does the C++ performance core, sr5_fast, play in this project?
options: It replaces Python entirely for all research tasks
It's exposed to Python via pybind11 and handles the rolling cross-sectional z-scores and the purged walk-forward retraining loop for speed
It only generates the final PDF report
It is used solely for plotting charts
questions.explain: sr5_fast is a C++17 module exposed to Python through pybind11, used specifically where Python is too slow: rolling cross-sectional z-scores and the walk-forward retraining loop.

questions.q: What is 'preregistration' in the context of this capstone's success criteria?
options: Registering the strategy with a regulator before trading it live
Committing to what counts as success or failure before seeing any results, so the goalposts can't be moved later
Signing up for a broker's early-access research program
Pre-ordering the C++ compiler license
questions.explain: Preregistration means defining success/failure criteria before results exist, borrowed from clinical research discipline, so findings can't be rationalized after the fact.

questions.q: Which of these is explicitly part of SR-5's preregistered success criteria?
options: A positive out-of-sample walk-forward Sharpe ratio net of realistic transaction costs
Beating the S&P 500 in every single calendar month
Achieving at least 50% annualized return
Having zero drawdown at any point in the backtest
questions.explain: Success requires, among other things, a positive out-of-sample walk-forward Sharpe ratio net of costs — not an unrealistic return target or zero drawdown.

questions.q: Where is the final written output of this capstone stored and compiled?
options: A PowerPoint file only, with no written report
A Markdown report compiled to PDF, plus a separate slide deck for the presentation
A single Excel workbook
An HTML page with no export format
questions.explain: The final report is written in Markdown and compiled to PDF, with the presentation built as a separate slide deck.
